profile.headline: Software Engineer at TreviPay, after acquisition of Apruve
profile.summary: I am a 2016 James Madison University alumni with a BS in Computer Science. I have almost four years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining business to business SaaS products that are built with JavaScript (Vue.js, JQuery) and PHP (CodeIgniter, Laravel) with desktop and mobile capability and are geared toward industrial use. The progressive web apps that I have worked on have been built for HR, Safety, Quality, and training in blue collar workplaces.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of skilled software engineers as a start up company to build a brand new SaaS progressive web app geared toward maintaining safety, quality, and training in the industrial settings
Used Vue.js, VueX, and Vuetify library and Webpack bundler for the front end. Axios HTTP client used for making API calls to the PHP Laravel backend and MySQL database
Currently maintaining and building on to the same software with a Git repository to better suit our current and prospective customers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained multiple large SaaS progressive web apps and APIs, including a learning management system, geared toward industrial use using PHP CodeIgniter, JQuery, Bootstrap CSS, and AJAX HTTP client with MySQL database.
Used LAMP stack environment and Git for the repository control

positions.title: eCorp Analyst
positions.description: Learn the hospital's new Electronic Medical Record system in order to assist the doctors and providers, as they adjust to the change.
